name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person: Code breaches first, then recalls, starter packs, follow-ups and who has not been seen

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Every breach and every rule clock in the records, with the section of the Code behind it. The same list as /compliance.
sections.sql: select severity, rule, ref, who, detail from v_issues order by case severity when 'breach' then 0 else 1 end, rule

sections.title: Starter packs and follow-ups
sections.sql: select 'starter pack' as item, ref, hcp as professional, product_name as detail, requested_on as since from v_samples where status = 'requested' union all select 'follow-up', c.ref, h.name, coalesce(c.next_step, 'follow up'), c.follow_up_on from calls c join hcps h on h.id = c.hcp_id where c.follow_up_done_on is null and c.follow_up_on <= current_date + 7 order by since

sections.title: Behind target this cycle
sections.sql: select territory, code, name, segment, target_calls as target, cycle_calls as calls, last_call_on, rep from v_hcps where status = 'active' and cycle_calls < target_calls order by territory, segment, last_call_on nulls first

name: coverage
title: Coverage
subtitle: Reach and frequency against the call plan, by territory and segment

sections.title: This cycle
sections.sql: select territory, segment, count(*)::int as professionals, sum(target_calls)::int as target_calls, sum(cycle_calls)::int as calls_made, count(*) filter (where cycle_calls > 0)::int as reached, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where cycle_calls >= target_calls) / count(*))::int as on_target_pct from v_hcps where status = 'active' and target_calls > 0 group by territory, segment order by territory, segment

sections.title: Calls by rep, last 30 days
sections.sql: select r.name as rep, count(*)::int as calls, count(distinct c.hcp_id)::int as professionals, count(*) filter (where c.channel = 'remote')::int as remote from calls c join reps r on r.id = c.rep_id where c.call_on >= current_date - 30 group by r.name order by calls desc

name: samples
title: Samples and stock
subtitle: Starter packs out, stock with each rep, and every recalled or expired lot

sections.title: Stock with reps
sections.sql: select rep, product_name as product, lot_number, expires_on, on_hand, standing from v_rep_stock order by case standing when 'recalled' then 0 when 'expired' then 1 when 'short-dated' then 2 else 3 end, rep

sections.title: Starter packs, last 90 days
sections.sql: select ref, hcp as professional, territory, product_name as product, quantity, requested_on, delivered_on, lot_number, receipt_signed_on as signed from v_samples where coalesce(delivered_on, requested_on) >= current_date - 90 order by coalesce(delivered_on, requested_on) desc

name: transparency
title: Transfers of value
subtitle: What goes to Disclosure Australia each half-year, and where each report stands

sections.title: Reports
sections.sql: select period_from, period_to, due_on, transfers, amount_cents, 'AUD' as currency, reviews_sent, submitted_on, declaration_on, standing from v_transparency order by period_from desc

sections.title: Reportable transfers, open periods
sections.sql: select x.ref, x.hcp as professional, x.kind, x.amount_cents, x.currency, x.paid_on, x.notice_given_on as notice, x.review_sent_on as review_sent, x.due_on from v_reportable x left join transparency_reports r on r.period_from = x.period_from where r.submitted_on is null order by x.paid_on
